title: Oklahoma 27, Nebraska 7: Keith Jackson's 88-Yard Run in 1985
question: What was the score of Oklahoma vs. Nebraska on November 23, 1985?
answer: Oklahoma beat Nebraska 27-7 at Owen Field on November 23, 1985, with No. 5 Oklahoma topping No. 2 Nebraska. Tight end Keith Jackson opened the scoring with an 88-yard touchdown run.
summary: On November 23, 1985, No. 5 Oklahoma beat No. 2 Nebraska 27-7 in Norman behind a Keith Jackson 88-yard touchdown run and 423 team rushing yards.
body: The Sooners and Cornhuskers met in Norman on Saturday, November 23, 1985, in an afternoon game on ABC at Owen Field. Oklahoma entered at 7-1 and ranked fifth. Nebraska arrived at 9-1 and ranked second, so the stakes went well beyond bragging rights in the Big Eight.

Oklahoma struck first. Tight end Keith Jackson took a reverse 88 yards for a touchdown in the first quarter, one of the longest runs in school history. Quarterback Jamelle Holieway, a freshman who had taken over the offense that season, followed with a 43-yard touchdown run of his own. Oklahoma led 14-0 after the first quarter and 17-0 at halftime.

The Sooners kept the ball on the ground all afternoon. They finished with 423 rushing yards to Nebraska's 161 and outgained the Huskers 461 yards to 224. Holieway ran for 110 yards, and the defense kept Nebraska off the board until the closing seconds, when the Huskers scored on a fumble return with 26 seconds left. Oklahoma held the ball for about 34 minutes to Nebraska's 26.

The win kept Oklahoma on course for the Orange Bowl and a shot at the national title. The Sooners went on to finish the 1985 season as national champions, and this November afternoon in Norman is remembered as one of the most complete performances of that run.
